purpose: A procedural dependency projection for one project; dispatch and runtime authority stay with the host.

nodes.label: Understand the job
nodes.artifact: Named buyer, owner, outcome, native platform and review revision

nodes.label: Shape the identity
nodes.artifact: Design direction, component states and approved asset family

nodes.label: Build the application
nodes.artifact: Working application, data boundaries and runtime evaluation evidence

nodes.label: Connect the infrastructure
nodes.artifact: Owned domain, deployment and mail records with recovery plan

nodes.label: Prove the experience
nodes.artifact: Observed complete user journey, including failure and recovery

nodes.label: Make it discoverable
nodes.artifact: Original content, crawl/index review and measurement baseline

nodes.label: Verify the commercial flow
nodes.artifact: Purchase, entitlement, cancellation and refund evidence

nodes.label: Review independently
nodes.artifact: Independent findings, repairs and remaining limitations

nodes.label: Rehearse delivery
nodes.artifact: Clean installation, native handoff and rollback rehearsal

nodes.label: Make it maintainable
nodes.artifact: Named operator, tested recovery, support and update procedure
